channel-group-type.label: Charging Profile
channel-group-type.description: One charging profile (saved charging location) of the vehicle - by default the one of the location the vehicle is currently at, or the profile configured on the vehicle thing. Changing a setting sends the complete profile to the vehicle; timers and preferred charging times are kept unchanged.

channel-type.label: Profile Name
channel-type.description: Name of the charging profile, as set in the MyŠkoda app.

channel-type.label: At Profile Location
channel-type.description: Whether the vehicle is at the location of this charging profile.

channel-type.label: Next Charging Time
channel-type.description: Next time (HH:mm, vehicle local time) charging is triggered by this profile. Only reported while the vehicle is at the profile's location.

channel-type.label: Profile Target State of Charge
channel-type.description: Target state of charge of this charging profile.

channel-type.label: Profile Max AC Charge Current
channel-type.description: Charge current used when charging starts at this profile's location.

channel-type.label: Profile Auto Unlock Plug When Charged
Minimum State of Charge Enabled
channel-type.description: Charge immediately, regardless of the profile's timers, while the battery is below the minimum state of charge.

channel-type.label: Minimum State of Charge
channel-type.description: Battery level below which charging starts immediately, if enabled.
